sentences.en: I hope I can manage to make both ends meet.
sentences.zh: 我希望我能设法维持收支平衡。

sentences.en: Can you manage to carry that heavy suitcase by yourself?
sentences.zh: 你能自己搬动那个沉重的手提箱吗？

sentences.en: I barely managed to finish the letter by eleven o'clock.
sentences.zh: 我勉强在十一点之前完成了那封信。
